title: Senior Graphic Designer
description: We are looking for a talented and experienced Senior Graphic Designer to join our creative team at Neza Designs. You will lead visual design initiatives for our clients across branding, print, and digital media, ensuring every output reflects our commitment to bold and purposeful design.
requirements: 5+ years of professional graphic design experience
Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)
Strong portfolio demonstrating brand identity and visual design work
Experience with print production and digital media design
Excellent understanding of typography, colour theory, and layout
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines
responsibilities: Lead end-to-end brand identity projects for clients
Design marketing materials including brochures, banners, and social media assets
Collaborate with project managers and clients to understand design briefs
Mentor junior designers and review their work
Ensure all designs meet brand guidelines and quality standards
Present design concepts and incorporate client feedback

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Neza Designs is seeking a creative and user-focused UI/UX Designer to craft intuitive digital experiences. You will work on web and mobile interfaces, transforming complex problems into elegant and user-friendly designs.
requirements: 3+ years of UI/UX design experience
Proficiency in Figma or Adobe XD
Strong understanding of user-centred design principles
Experience conducting user research and usability testing
Knowledge of responsive and mobile-first design
Portfolio showcasing web and mobile design work
responsibilities: Design wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups
Conduct user research to inform design decisions
Collaborate with developers to ensure accurate implementation
Define and maintain design systems and component libraries
Present design concepts to clients and stakeholders
Iterate based on user feedback and testing results

title: Web Developer
description: We are hiring a skilled Web Developer to build and maintain high-quality websites and web applications for our clients. You will work closely with the design team to bring visuals to life with clean, performant code.
requirements: 3+ years of front-end or full-stack web development experience
Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript
Experience with React, Next.js or similar frameworks
Familiarity with Node.js and RESTful APIs
Understanding of web performance optimisation
Version control with Git
responsibilities: Develop responsive websites and web applications from design mockups
Integrate with backend APIs and third-party services
Optimise web applications for performance and SEO
Collaborate with designers and project managers
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices

title: Project Manager
description: Neza Designs is looking for a proactive and organised Project Manager to oversee client projects from inception to delivery. You will ensure projects are completed on time, within scope, and to the highest standard.
requirements: 3+ years of project management experience, preferably in a creative agency
PMP or PRINCE2 certification is a plus
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Experience with project management tools (Trello, Asana, or similar)
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
Problem-solving mindset and attention to detail
responsibilities: Plan and manage project timelines, resources, and budgets
Act as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the project lifecycle
Coordinate between design, development, and content teams
Identify and mitigate project risks
Prepare project reports and status updates for clients
Ensure deliverables meet quality standards before client handover

title: Content & Social Media Specialist
description: We are seeking a creative and data-driven Content & Social Media Specialist to manage content creation and social media presence for Neza Designs and our clients. You will craft compelling stories that connect brands with their audiences.
requirements: 1–3 years of experience in content creation or social media management
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Experience managing social media platforms (Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Facebook)
Basic graphic design skills (Canva or Adobe tools)
Understanding of SEO and content marketing principles
Analytical mindset with ability to interpret engagement metrics
responsibilities: Develop and execute content calendars for social media platforms
Write engaging copy for posts, blogs, newsletters, and campaigns
Create visual content in collaboration with the design team
Monitor and respond to community engagement
Track and report on content performance metrics
Stay up to date with industry trends and platform updates

title: Motion Graphics Designer
description: Neza Designs is looking for a Motion Graphics Designer to create engaging animated content for client campaigns, social media, and presentations. You bring designs to life with movement and storytelling.
requirements: 3+ years of motion graphics or animation experience
Proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro
Strong understanding of timing, pacing, and visual storytelling
Experience creating content for social media and digital platforms
Knowledge of 3D animation (Cinema 4D) is a plus
Portfolio demonstrating motion graphics and animation work
responsibilities: Create animated graphics for social media, video, and presentations
Collaborate with the design team to animate static assets
Produce motion content aligned with client brand guidelines
Edit and post-produce video content as needed
Manage multiple animation projects within tight deadlines
